property_summary: For all callers, setOwner can only be successfully invoked when the caller is the original admin (the deployer); the mutant that checks owner instead of admin allows the current owner to call setOwner and so can change owner when called by a non-admin owner.
change_summary: Changed the access check in onlyAdmin to require msg.sender == owner instead of admin so owner (not admin) can call setOwner, altering post-call owner when invoked by owner.
